blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Over P3.2 million worth of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) was intercepted and four individuals were arrested during a back-to-back anti-drug operations here and in the island province of Camiguin. In an advisory Saturday, Oct. 3, Brig. Gen. Nestor Babagay Jr., Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) director, lauded the operatives and vowed to sustain strict, intelligence-driven campaigns against illegal drugs across Northern Mindanao. “These operations show our firm resolve against the illegal drugs trade. We will intensify our operations, strengthen intelligence efforts, and hold those involved accountable,” he said. The bulk of the illegal drugs was seized late […]...
